title: A member who brings two friends with the same name gets the thank-you days only once
what: The check that stops a second tap from giving the Bring a friend days twice looks only for the friend's name on the member's plan notes. If the same member later brings another friend with the same name (two people called Rahul), the second thank-you is skipped without a word, yet the enquiry is marked as rewarded and shows the days as given.
expected: The repeat check is tied to that one enquiry, so each friend's thank-you is given once, and the screen never says days were given when they were not.
fix_line: Mark the thank-you with the enquiry it belongs to, not the friend's name

title: If the every-minute job that sends gym alerts stops, no gym gets alerts with the app closed and nobody is told
what: Alerts with the admin app closed (a new online join, a pause or renew request, a member message) are sent by a job that runs every minute. When that job fails, or its sending key is missing or wrong, it writes only a hidden log line (the key warning only once). Every gym quietly stops getting these alerts. An owner finds out only by pressing 'Send a test alert', or by noticing missed requests.
expected: A failed or switched-off alert run raises an alert to MettleUp the same way a failed backup does.
fix_line: Report a failed or skipped alert run to MettleUp like the backup status

title: Nobody can tell whether gyms send renewal and come-back reminders
what: The ready WhatsApp messages (plan ending, plan ended, haven't seen you, gym news) are the main tool for keeping members, but which members were sent one is kept only in that one browser. Nothing reaches the gym server, so MettleUp cannot see how many gyms use reminders or whether reminders bring renewals, and an owner on a second device sees an empty list.
expected: A count of reminders opened per gym and message type (no member details) is kept on the server and shown in HQ next to renewals.
fix_line: Count reminders opened per gym on the server and show it in HQ

items.reason: Only the panel's timed checks run over time: they stop while the tab is hidden and look again on return, and alerts with the tab closed go by web push. Heart rate, workout clock and watch-off-wrist do not apply to a web page.
